api.name: SetAnim
api.description: SetAnim and all of its variants set the weight of an animation (or a node in the animtree) to a given value over a given time. They also set the speed at which the animation plays. All of the ancestors of the animation will also have their weight set to 1 over the given time so that the animation is visible. Each variant of this function has different behavior depending on the words in the function name: "Flagged": These functions take an additional argument <notifyname> (first in the argument list) which is a string that is notified for every notetrack in the animation. For instance, if the string "runanim" is used, it would be typical to waittill("runanim", "end") to wait for the end of the animation. <animation> must be an actual animation and not a non-leaf node of the animtree. "Knob": These functions turn the weight of any siblings of the animation to zero as the animation's weight is turned up. The effect is that after the given time, the animation is the only one out of its siblings that is playing. Note that the descendents of the siblings of the animation will not be turned off directly. (For this, use ClearAnim.) "All": Works only with "Knob." Not available with both "Limited" and "Flagged" at the same time. These functions take an additional argument <root> (after the animation argument). <root> must be an ancestor of <animation> in the tree. This has the additional effect that "Knob" has on all nodes from the animation up to (but not including) <root>, so that this animation is the only one in its area of the tree which is playing. "Limited": These functions do not change the goal weight of the ancestors of <animation> (If "KnobAll" is used, this means the ancestors of <root>). This means that the animation might not be visible if any of its ancestors currently have a weight of 0. However, when its ancestors' weight is changed, it will become visible. "Restart": These functions cause the animation to restart. If they had been previously playing, without this they would continue from their current time.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.description: : The name of a dvar. Valid dvar names: "cg_drawhud".

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: : The the value to which the dvar will be set

api.name: SetDvar
api.description: Sets the value of a script dvar. Can not set code dvars. Script dvars are not preserved in savegames.

parameters.name: dvar
parameters.description: The dvar name as a string.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The dvar value.

api.name: SetFlaggedAnimKnob
api.description: See "SetAnim."

parameters.name: notifyname
parameters.description: The string to notify notetracks with.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

api.name: SetLightIntensity
api.description: Sets the current intensity of the light.

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: A new value for the intensity of the light. 1 is fullbright, but values can be larger than 1.

api.name: SetModel
api.description: Sets the model of the entity to the given model name

parameters.name: model_name
parameters.description: The name of the model to set this entity to

api.name: SetReverb
api.description: Set the sound reverberation for the player

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: : Valid priorities are "snd_enveffectsprio_level", or "snd_enveffectsprio_shellshock".

parameters.name: room_type
parameters.description: : string describing the type of reverb.

parameters.name: dry_level
parameters.description: : a float from 0 (no source sound) to 1 (full source sound)

parameters.name: wet_level
parameters.description: : a float from 0 (no effect) to 1 (full effect)

parameters.name: fade_time
parameters.description: : in seconds and modifies drylevel and wetlevel.

api.name: SetSavedDvar
api.description: Sets the value of a code "SAVED" dvar. Saved dvars are preserved in save games, and reset to default on level change.

parameters.name: dvar
parameters.description: The dvar name as a string.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The dvar value.

api.name: SetSunLight
api.description: Overrides the sun color for a level. Use 'resetSunLight' to revert to the map's values.

parameters.name: red
parameters.description: The red component of sunlight color. 0 is black, 1 is fullbright, more than 1 is overbright.

parameters.name: green
parameters.description: The green component of sunlight color. 0 is black, 1 is fullbright, more than 1 is overbright.

parameters.name: blue
parameters.description: The blue component of sunlight color. 0 is black, 1 is fullbright, more than 1 is overbright.

api.name: ShellShock
api.description: Start a shell shock sequence for the player. The shell shock must be precached, otherwise calling this script will cause a script error.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: duration in seconds. The duration must be between 0 and 60 seconds.

parameters.name: overridecheat
parameters.description: Certain player cheats can disable this function, set this true to force the issue.

api.name: Show
api.description: Shows a hidden entity

api.name: Sin
api.description: Returns the sin of an angle

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: An angle in degrees

api.name: Spawn
api.description: Spawns a new entity and returns a reference to the entity

parameters.name: classname
parameters.description: The name of the class to spawn (constant string)

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position where the entity is to be spawned (vector)

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: spawn flags (integer)

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: If the entity is a 'trigger_radius' entity then this is the radius of the trigger. Otherwise this parameter is invalid.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: If the entity is a 'trigger_radius' entity then this is the height of the trigger. Otherwise this parameter is invalid.

api.name: SpawnFx
api.description: Create an effect entity that can be re-triggered efficiently at arbitrary intervals. This doesn't play the effect. Use delete to free it when done.

parameters.name: effect_id
parameters.description: The effect id returned by loadfx.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position of the effect.

parameters.name: forward
parameters.description: The forward vector for the effect

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: The up vector for the effect

api.name: SpawnStruct
api.description: Allocates a structure

api.name: StopLoopSound
api.description: Stop a looping sound

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The splitscreen client this call acts on, 0-3. Client scripts run one script VM per splitscreen client.

api.name: StopRumble
api.description: Quits the playing of a particular rumble on a player.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The splitscreen client this call acts on, 0-3. Client scripts run one script VM per splitscreen client.

parameters.name: rumble_name
parameters.description: The name of the rumble to stop

api.name: StopSounds
api.description: Stop all sounds on an entity. *WARNING*, You must have a wait between StopSounds() and delete() or the sound will not stop.

api.name: StrTok
api.description: Tokenizes <string> by the delimiters <delim>. Returns the array of string tokens.

api.name: TableLookup
api.description: look up a row in a table and pull out a particular column from that row

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The table to look up

parameters.name: search_column_num
parameters.description: The column number of the stats table to search through

parameters.name: search_value
parameters.description: The value to use when searching the <search column num>

parameters.name: return_value_column_num
parameters.description: The column number value to return after we find the correct row

api.name: Tan
api.description: Returns the tan of an angle

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: An angle in degrees

api.name: ToLower
api.description: Converts <string> to a lower case string which is returned.

api.name: TriggerFX
api.description: Replays the effect associated with the effect entity. This does not kill any existing effects.

parameters.name: effect_entity
parameters.description: The effect id returned by loadfx.

parameters.name: when
parameters.description: The time at which the effect should be triggered. This can be in the past.

api.name: Unlink
api.description: Unlinks a linked entity from another entity

api.name: UpdateGamerProfile
api.description: Saves the player's gamer profile. Does nothing on PC.

api.name: UseAnimTree
api.description: Set the animation tree of an entity

parameters.name: anim_tree
parameters.description: The new anim tree

api.name: VectorDot
api.description: Returns the dot product of two vectors

parameters.name: vector_a
parameters.description: The first vector

parameters.name: vector_b
parameters.description: The second vector

api.name: VectorFromLineToPoint
api.description: Given a line and a point P, this returns a vector perpendicular to the line and pointing from the line to P.

parameters.name: segmenta
parameters.description: One point on the line

parameters.name: segmentb
parameters.description: Another point on the line

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: The point

api.name: VectorLerp
api.description: Linear interpolates between two vectors.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The vector whose value is used when fraction is 0

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The vector whose value is used when fraction is 1

parameters.name: fraction
parameters.description: The fraction of the way between vectors. Values less than 0 or greater than 1 do linear extrapolation.

api.example: color = VectorLerp( oldColor, newColor, timeElapsed / timeTotal );

api.name: VectorNormalize
api.description: Returns a normalized copy of this vector

parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: The vector to normalize

api.name: VectorToAngles
api.description: Returns a set of angles corresponding to the given vector.

parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: The vector to convert to angles

api.name: VisionSetNaked
api.description: Sets players' naked-eye vision. Optionally give a transition time from the current vision.

parameters.name: localClientNum
parameters.description: The splitscreen client this call acts on, 0-3. Client scripts run one script VM per splitscreen client.

parameters.name: vision_name
parameters.description: Vision to transition to.

parameters.name: transition_time
parameters.description: How long, in seconds, to take transitioning to the new vision set if a transition is possible. Default is one second.
